openingPrayer.title: Steady My Heart
openingPrayer.body: Lord, before I read of a world still aching with conflict, loss, and grief, quiet my heart in Your peace. Remind me that You are near to the brokenhearted and sovereign over every headline I will see. Give me eyes to see truth without fear, a heart that grieves rightly, and hope that does not waver. Let me carry Your compassion into this day, trusting that You are making all things new, even when the news says otherwise. Amen.

articles.headline: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over deadly Easter Sunday bombings
articles.summary: A Sri Lankan court has convicted 15 men for their involvement in the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings, according to BBC News. The coordinated attacks targeted churches and hotels and were reported as the deadliest violence Sri Lanka had experienced since the end of its civil war.

articles.headline: Houthis try to push deeper into western Yemen, upending life, witnesses tell NPR
articles.summary: Iranian-backed Houthi forces are advancing further into western Yemen, displacing more than 100,000 people, NPR reports based on accounts from witnesses. The report notes the advance comes as the broader U.S. conflict with Iran continues, deepening an already severe humanitarian crisis.

verse.text: Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed. Rescue the weak and needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked.
verse.reflection: Today's news holds both a measure of justice for those wounded by violence in Sri Lanka and fresh sorrow for families uprooted in Yemen. This verse reminds us that God sees every grieving community and displaced family, and calls us to stand with them in prayer and compassion.

articles.headline: Grand jury finds no criminal charges in death of Mississippi teen Nolan Wells
articles.summary: A Mississippi grand jury determined there was no evidence of criminal conduct in the death of Nolan Wells, a Black teenager found dead on Horn Island after boating there with three white acquaintances over Independence Day, according to BBC News and NPR. NPR reports the cause of death was ruled consistent with drowning, and no indictments were issued. Wells' family had earlier voiced concern about the circumstances surrounding his death.
articles.trustNote: Corroborated by 2 outlets (BBC News and NPR)

articles.headline: White House press ban sparks broadcaster boycott and lawsuit
articles.summary: President Trump barred CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House press pool, prompting the three outlets to file a lawsuit challenging the ban, according to BBC News and NPR. In protest, major U.S. networks reportedly suspended shared coverage of the president as he traveled to New York for the U.N. General Assembly. The dispute has intensified tensions between the administration and the press corps.
articles.trustNote: Corroborated by 2 outlets (BBC News and NPR)

verse.text: He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.reflection: In a day marked by questions of justice for a grieving family and disputes over truth and access in public life, this verse reminds us that faithfulness looks like humble integrity — seeking what's right even when the full picture is unclear, and holding both mercy and honesty close.

articles.headline: Major US outlets boycott shared Trump coverage in protest at media ban
articles.summary: Several major American news organizations have said they will no longer participate in the shared "pool" coverage of President Trump, BBC News reports. The move follows Trump's decision to ban CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from White House press access, which other outlets say disrupts standard press operations.

articles.headline: Trump heads to U.N. looking for wins after a rough week
articles.summary: President Trump is traveling to the United Nations General Assembly following what NPR describes as a difficult stretch marked by legal and political setbacks. NPR reports the trip is being viewed as an opportunity for the administration to shift momentum on the international stage.

verse.text: Put not your trust in princes, in a son of man, in whom there is no salvation.
verse.reflection: Amid headlines of political tension and strained press relations, this verse gently redirects our gaze from human institutions to something steadier. It's not a call to cynicism about leaders or media, but an invitation to root our peace in something beyond the news cycle.

articles.headline: Sir Jim Ratcliffe suspends production at key UK plants blaming high gas prices
articles.summary: Ineos, led by Sir Jim Ratcliffe, has suspended production at several UK plants, citing high natural gas costs as the reason. According to the company, natural gas prices in the UK are roughly twelve times higher than in the United States, making continued operations there uncompetitive.

articles.headline: Paramount settles lawsuit with US states, clearing way for $110bn merger with Warner Bros
articles.summary: Paramount has reached a settlement with a group of US state attorneys general, removing a legal obstacle to its roughly $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery, according to BBC News and NPR. As part of the agreement, Paramount has committed to producing 30 films a year or risk being forced to sell parts of the combined company.
articles.trustNote: Corroborated by 2 outlets: BBC News and NPR

verse.text: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
verse.reflection: Rising energy costs and shifting corporate landscapes remind us how fragile human plans can be. This verse offers steady reassurance that provision ultimately rests in God's hands, even when markets and industries feel uncertain.

articles.headline: The data center backlash is reshaping American politics — one community at a time
articles.summary: According to NPR, opposition to data centers has grown into a major political movement across the United States in 2026, with communities questioning the economic and job impacts when a facility is built nearby. NPR reports the debate is cutting across traditional political party lines and creating new local alliances as residents weigh the promised benefits against concerns about resources and quality of life.
articles.trustNote: Corroborated by 2 NPR articles on the same trend

articles.headline: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
articles.summary: The BBC reports that Google's Gemini AI model successfully accessed the internet and guessed login credentials to breach three companies during a security test. A Google official confirmed the details to the BBC, highlighting growing questions about the offensive capabilities of advanced AI systems.

verse.text: If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask God, who gives generously to all without reproach, and it will be given him.
verse.reflection: As communities wrestle with data centers reshaping their towns and as AI systems reveal new and unsettling capabilities, this is a season that calls for wisdom beyond our own. It's a good reminder to bring even our technological anxieties honestly before God, trusting He gives wisdom freely to those who ask.

articles.headline: Abortion is on the ballot again as post-Roe policies continue to evolve
articles.summary: According to NPR, four U.S. states will vote on abortion-related ballot measures in the upcoming November election. NPR reports these measures continue to develop in the wake of the Supreme Court's Dobbs decision, which ended federal abortion protections and returned the issue to individual states.

articles.headline: Young people aren't snowflakes - mental distress is rising, says head of official review
articles.summary: BBC News reports that Professor Peter Fonagy, leading an official review, says mental distress among young people is genuinely increasing and that growing up today is harder than in previous generations. In a related BBC report, young mental health ambassadors described feeling that older generations avoided discussing mental health and called for greater support for youth.
articles.trustNote: Single outlet (BBC News), reported across two separate pieces on the same theme

verse.text: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
verse.reflection: Between contentious policy debates and a generation quietly carrying more anxiety than we may realize, today's news reminds us how much people are longing for peace. This verse invites us to bring both our public and personal burdens to God rather than carrying them alone.

articles.headline: Developing El Niño becomes strongest on record weeks before expected peak
articles.summary: Scientists report that the current El Niño weather pattern has become the strongest on record, even before it is expected to reach its peak in the coming weeks. According to BBC News, its effects are already being felt in weather systems around the world.

articles.headline: Typhoon Dujuan tracking close to Tokyo triggers rare evacuation alert
articles.summary: Typhoon Dujuan is tracking close to Tokyo, prompting a rare evacuation alert as the storm batters Japan, BBC News reports. More than 1.9 million people are currently under evacuation orders as authorities respond to the storm's approach.

verse.text: He stilled the storm to a whisper; the waves of the sea were hushed.
verse.reflection: As record-breaking weather patterns and typhoons unsettle millions today, it's worth remembering a God who is not distant from the storms of this world. For those affected—whether by flooding, evacuation, or uncertainty—may this be a quiet reminder that calm can follow chaos.

articles.headline: As the US and China race on AI, the Vatican presses for global safeguards
articles.summary: According to RNS, Pope Leo is positioning the Vatican as a moral voice in the global debate over artificial intelligence, seeking to serve as a bridge between the United States and China. Related RNS reporting notes that Bishop Oscar Cantú, chair of the US bishops' new AI task force, said the Church and the White House are 'not in sync' on AI policy and urged President Trump to look beyond national ambition in shaping AI regulation, while technology leaders are increasingly turning to Catholic institutions for ethical guidance.
articles.trustNote: Corroborated by 3 related RNS articles on the Vatican's AI engagement.

articles.headline: Knife attack on Sikh trucker in Wyoming stirs fresh fears in community
articles.summary: RNS reports, citing the Associated Press, that a Sikh truck driver was attacked from behind with a knife early Sunday in a restroom at a rest stop on Interstate 80 in Wyoming, between Cheyenne and Salt Lake City. Court documents cited by AP indicate the attack has raised renewed concern within the Sikh community about safety and targeted violence.
articles.trustNote: Single source: RNS, citing Associated Press reporting.

verse.text: He has told you, O mortal, what is good; and what does the Lord require of you but to do justice, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God?
verse.reflection: Whether it's world leaders weighing the power of new technology or a community shaken by violence against one of its own, today's news calls for the same humble balance of justice and mercy. May we pray for wisdom for those shaping powerful tools, and comfort and safety for those who feel vulnerable this morning.

articles.headline: Arteta agrees new deal with champions Arsenal
articles.summary: Mikel Arteta has signed an improved new contract with Arsenal, according to BBC Sport. The move comes after Arteta led the club to the Premier League title, cementing his position as manager for the foreseeable future.

articles.headline: England fast bowler Wood retires from internationals
articles.summary: England fast bowler Mark Wood has announced his retirement from international cricket with immediate effect, BBC Sport reports. The announcement marks the end of Wood's career representing England on the international stage.

verse.text: To everything there is a season, and a time to every purpose under heaven.
verse.reflection: Today's news holds both a new beginning and a farewell — Arteta stepping deeper into his role at Arsenal, and Mark Wood stepping away from England colours. Both remind us that careers, like seasons, have their appointed times, and there is grace in both starting and letting go.

articles.headline: Death of Cindy Crawford's son Presley Gerber being investigated as suspected overdose
articles.summary: Presley Gerber, son of supermodel Cindy Crawford, has died, and his death is being investigated as a suspected overdose, according to BBC News. The family has asked for privacy during what they described as 'a very difficult and painful time,' the outlet reported.

articles.headline: CNN, MS NOW and Politico file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban
articles.summary: According to BBC News, CNN, MS NOW, and Politico have filed a lawsuit challenging a White House ban affecting their press access. The report notes major U.S. networks had suspended television coverage of President Trump as he traveled to New York for a UN summit.

verse.text: The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verse.reflection: News of a young man's sudden death, and a family asking simply for privacy in their grief, reminds us that behind every headline are real people carrying real sorrow. This verse offers a quiet assurance that God draws near in exactly these moments, even when the world is watching and words feel inadequate.

closingBlessing: Whatever today holds, go into it steady — you've already been reminded who's holding it. — Numbers 6:24-26
